column1: # Three-way coverage verdict, one line per in-scope row of the Pro-gated toolset
# sections of ACROBAT-PARITY.md. Tally with parity/tools/coverage-tally.py.
#   Rb reachable and captured: the row's own controls appear in a frame of the
#      pinned build (source class B). Naming, grouping, ordering, default and
#      enabled state, relative geometry, iconography and colour are obtainable.
#      These rows and only these can feed a geometry or token ledger.
#   Ra reachable by accessibility query: the row's own command is a live entry
#      the pinned build reports about itself (source class A). Naming, index,
#      grouping, enabled state and shortcut are obtainable; no geometry, no
#   D  documentation-sourceable only: Adobe's public prose names the row's
#      principal controls. Naming, field lists and step order are obtainable;
#      grouping only inside a verbatim quoted path; no geometry, iconography,
#   N  neither source established it in this pass. N is a statement about this
#      pass, not about the world: see section 7.4 of the method document.
# Rb and Ra together are the "reachable in the installed Reader" bucket. Only Rb
# supports the token and geometry layers of docs/plans/parity-goal.md.
